description: This file provides centralized helper functions for activity logging within a Django project, emphasizing non-blocking behavior, tenant safety, and integration with various parts of the application such as views, signals, and commands. It includes functions to log user activities and model events, extract client IPs, resolve organizational context, and handle exceptions gracefully.

methods.name: str|None _get_client_ip(request)
methods.description: Extracts the client IP address from a request object, considering proxies and remote address.

methods.name: str _safe_obj_repr(instance: Any)
methods.description: Generates a short, stable string representation of a model instance, handling exceptions.

methods.name: Any _resolve_org(request, instance)
methods.description: Determines the organization/tenant context from request or instance based on priority.

methods.name: None log_activity( *, actor: Any | None, action: str, object_type: str, object_id: str = "", object_repr: str = "", metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None, org: Any | None = None, request: Any | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates an activity log entry for a user action, handling exceptions non-blockingly.

methods.name: None log_model_event(*, instance: Any, action: str, request: Any | None = None)
methods.description: Convenience function to log CRUD events for a model instance, handling exceptions gracefully.
